title: PeopleOS Brief — 2026-07-13
subject: PeopleOS Brief — July 13, 2026 Intelligence
preheader: 12-section daily executive intelligence across markets, AI, HR, and economics.
executive_summary: India's job market is experiencing high mobility despite potential slowdown concerns, while globally, layoffs continue to make headlines, including Microsoft's recent cut of 4800 jobs. The global economy is also being impacted by rising oil prices and inflation fears, leading to market fluctuations in the US and India. Additionally, significant developments in AI are emerging, with new research papers on LLM agents and evaluation, as well as major company moves. Jaishankar's upcoming address at the Global Technology Summit is also expected to shed light on the intersection of technology and geopolitics.
